title: Unit Event — The Song of a Canary in Crisis — Episode7 The 30th Anniversary Show

meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis
meta.Event Outline: As the 30th Anniversary Show approaches, Nene is hard at work preparing for her role as the Cowardly Canary. However, during a rehearsal, the director criticizes not her acting, but her singing...

rows.Line: Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: This place is packed. It really feels like a big anniversary show.

rows.Speaker: Seiichi
rows.Line:
Yeah, it does.
But this also feels so strange...

rows.Speaker: Seiichi
rows.Line: Who would've thought that the first show I'd see in Japan after all this time would be “The Happy Phoenix.”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Haha. Small world, huh?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: At the same time, the cast must be feeling the pressure. I mean, Amami, I have to think they know you're here.

rows.Speaker: Seiichi
rows.Line:
Speak for yourself.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Seiichi
rows.Line: Anyone who buckles under this sort of pressure really doesn't belong on stage in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Seiichi
rows.Line: All audience members are on equal footing. It doesn't matter if you're a king or a starving student.

rows.Speaker: Seiichi
rows.Line: We're no exception...

rows.Speaker: Seiichi
rows.Line: As such, I believe actors who lose sight of that fact don't belong on stage.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Hehe. You and your stubborn stage philosophy. Still...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I hope you're right.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Break a leg, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Western Forest Swallow
rows.Line: “Hey, do any of you know about the really beautiful bird living deep within this forest?!”

rows.Speaker: Western Forest Swallow
rows.Line: “There's no one like her in the western forest. I wish there were a way for me to talk to her.”

rows.Speaker: Eccentric Crow
rows.Line:
“Do you speak of the phoenix?
You poor fool. She may look ravishing, but her heart is made of ice...”

rows.Speaker: Featherbrained Duck
rows.Line: “Oh, Swallow, that's right. It's only been two days since you came to this forest... Or was it a week? I forget...”

rows.Speaker: Gossiping Starling
rows.Line: “Regardless, allow me to tell you all about her. She's...”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (Their singing and acting is stupendous. I suppose they're nationally-renowned cast for a reason...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (But the meat of this show involves...)

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “That creature over there looks unfamiliar. So small and helpless... How repulsive.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “It must be a human. A child at that.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “My hate for it knows no bounds.”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (She was so little when I performed alongside her, but she definitely had this spark... Still, I never thought that she'd blossom like this so soon...!)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (There's no question that she's the future of show business. I can see why Nene was so anxious...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (But you also have some tricks up your sleeve now...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (So, show me what you've got!)

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Wait, please... Phoenix!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The phoenix leaves Rio far behind and them becoming separated marks the end of the first act...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, which means...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The next scene's where Nene and Tsukasa meet for the very first time! I can't wait to hear her sing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, me neither.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(She's more focused that usual.
We probably shouldn't do anything to break her concentration.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In any case, we shall see what she's gained over this short period and how she performs...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be on the edge of our seats...

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “No, I lost her again...”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “At this rate, I'm never going to catch up to her, let alone capture her...”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
If only I had wings like her...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's Nene's cue...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The Cowardly Canary's personality involves “speaking through song”. Thus, her first line on stage it not spoken but sung.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Starting by humming.
Then, she slowly transitions to singing...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which reaches Rio's ears...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She sounds totally different compared to before...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, her tone's much lower.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's normal for anyone to believe that a canary would sing in a high pitch based on its natural size.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Nene initially went with that image during our practices it seems.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But she's lowered her tone...
Is it to conserve stamina? She likely won't have any trouble getting through this song now...)

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Who's singing? Is it that bird...?”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“What a beautiful voice...
I'd like to hear it more up close...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“H-Huh?!
Who's there...?!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That felt...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
How did she do that?
Her line matched her singing so perfectly just now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it did...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, when the director said her singing “sticks out”, he meant that her acting and singing felt completely disconnected from one another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's thrown aside singing in a high pitch like a real bird and went with something closer to her regular voice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A brave decision on her part...
As a result, her singing and acting are meshing together much nicer compared to when she was trying to “become a canary”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, she sounds like a real canary that “speaks through song”.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I really like this version of her...
And she looks like she's having so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is Nene's Cowardly Canary...

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“U-Umm...
Thank you for praising my singing.”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“I really love to sing...
I mean, it's how I communicate.”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“No, it might be more than that...
Unfortunately, I'm not very good at talking to other people...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “But since you said that you enjoyed my song so much, I wouldn't mind singing another one for you...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “It's been so long since someone last heard me sing...”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (Good. Her training seems to be paying off...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (If she can keep this up, that other scene should be...)

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Phoenix...?”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Wh-Why did you come back...?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Here comes the climax...
Rio thought he'd never see the phoenix again after she dropped a feather for him to use to recover.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But his mother only has until sunset, which is just moments away. The phoenix appearing before Rio once more out of her own volition means...)

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“It is true that I wished to continue living.
However, I also enjoyed these past few days we spent together...”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “You enjoyed spending time with me...?”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“No, that is not quite correct...
To be more precise, I enjoyed laughing and frolicking with you.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “However, if you lose your mother, that smile of yours will surely vanish along with her. If that were to happen...”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “I would deeply regret not giving you my heart.”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Phoenix...”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Which is why...
I have decided that it is not worth living if it means you will no longer smile.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“So, take this knife...
Plunge it into me and take my heart.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Hehe...
You truly are a weak, little coward.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “However, I shall leave you with some parting words.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Becoming friends with you filled me with so much joy...”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“Wh-Why...?
Really? Now...?”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“What am I supposed to do...?!
How do you expect me to...?!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can feel Rio's pain wrapping itself around my heart...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Me too...
Seiryuin's also putting on a tremendous performance. Her voice and facial expressions are so captivating...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(These two really are something else.
They're the protagonists in every sense of the word.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, one person must bring them together.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(This is a key moment in the story...
A perfect performance will be required to compel these two to come to an agreement.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, we shall see how this plays out...)

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“I'm sorry...
I'm so sorry, Phoenix...”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “For my mom's sake... I... I...!”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “W-Wait...!”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“Please, wait...!
Stop, you two...!”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Fear not, Rio...”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “I do not fear death for I am a majestic phoenix...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“I... I have to tell them...
They don't need a phoenix's heart to cure Rio's mother of her curse...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “My voice... I'm so scared...”

rows.Speaker: Witch
rows.Line:
“So, you have figured out my secret...
But if you tell those two, your life is forfeit!”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“I-If I tell them... She'll take my life...
But... But...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“Rio said that he likes my singing...
He became friends with me even though I'm afraid of just about everything...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“So, I... I don't want him to feel sad...
I don't want him to stab Phoenix...
I don't want him to stab his friend...!”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“I have to stop them...
I'll never forgive myself if I don't.”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“But just telling them isn't going to work...
No, I can sing to them...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “With this song!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Her voice... It's going straight for my heart as it leaves her mouth, and I can feel her desperation so clearly...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I had no idea she could sing like this...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (She's overcome all of the walls she ran into during our training...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (Youth really is a scary thing...)

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “This song...!”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“This must be that canary...
I believe she is trying to tell us something...”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “What...? The heart of a phoenix is not required to dispel the curse that has been placed on Rio's mother...?”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Instead, we must defeat the witch...?!”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “R-Really...?”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “The witch had me fooled this whole time...?”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Phoenix, this means I don't have to use this knife anymore.”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“Thank goodness...
I'm so relieved...”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Oh, for the love of... Why are you crying? Quickly now. Stand up.”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Wait, what...?”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Time is of the essence for the sun will be setting soon. We must hurry and defeat the witch before then.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“I shall follow you...
She will not be easy to fall, we should be able to win if we fight together.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Because we are friends...”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (The entire audience has their attention focused on the stage...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (They even seem overcome with relief that Rio and the phoenix were able to find a solution...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (Those two obviously did a magnificent job of immersing us into the story, but...)

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “Thank goodness...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “I'm so glad they heard my song...”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: What an incredible performance.
